name: musesys_mcp
author: MuseSystems
description: MuseSys Model Context Protocol server. stdio JSON-RPC 2.0 bridge exposing the WooCommerce/MuseSys backend (orders, logistics, product requests, catalog, assets, exports) to LLMs and AI agents per STATE_OF_THE_APP.md Part 2. Enforces UACP validation gates (7-digit WO, 3-digit zero-padded store, strict YYYY-MM-DD dates, status normalization) and 429/5xx exponential backoff.
notes: Config: MUSESYS_* env vars override UACP settings.json (active_site schema; searched beside script, repo root, cwd). Register in claude_desktop_config.json or any MCP client. See README.md for client config snippet.
